title: OpenCode Agent Markdown Frontmatter Schema
description: YAML frontmatter schema for OpenCode agent markdown files. Source: Config.Agent Zod schema in packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

mode.description: Determines how the agent can be used

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent

temperature.description: Controls the randomness and creativity of the LLM's responses

top_p.description: Alternative to temperature for controlling randomness

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

disable.description: Set to true to disable the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu

color.description: Hex color code or theme color

additionalProperties.description: Provider-specific options passed through to the model
